summary.text: Joe Madge is the Democratic candidate for the South Carolina House of Representatives, District 89, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as an engineer with more than 30 years of experience who has lived in South Carolina for over 30 years.

paragraphs.text: Joe Madge graduated from Paul V. Moore High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Pennsylvania in 1990.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as engineer, and in a Ballotpedia survey he said he has more than 30 years of experience solving problems and has raised his family in South Carolina.

Madge listed three campaign messages in the survey: improving affordability by increasing the minimum wage and reducing the cost of living, especially health care; improving infrastructure, including roads, bridges and public transport; and investing in public education, with a focus on students who plan to enter the job market after high school.
He said he is passionate about restoring checks and balances to government instead of one-party rule.
